title: " CHOSIN TO HUNGNAM " KOREAN WAR DOCUMENTARY CHOSIN RESERVOIR USMC MARINE CORPS 81594
summary: This black & white educational film is about the Battle of the Chosin Reservoir, a campaign early in the Korean War, part of the Chinese Second Offensive (November–December 1950) to drive the United Nations out of North Korea. This film has a 1951 copyright. A foreword that explains what we about to see shows the US Marines in the bitter struggle from the Chosin Reservoir to Hungnam, Korea. Credit
